#!/usr/bin/env bash
set -euo pipefail

BASE="$(git rev-parse HEAD)"
export BASE
export RUN_ID="${GITHUB_RUN_ID:-}"
export RUN_ATTEMPT="${GITHUB_RUN_ATTEMPT:-}"
SELF=.github/workflows/comprehensive-code-closure-v3-once.yml
PARTS=.github/comprehensive-closure-v3-parts
RUNTIME_TEST=tests/test_runtime_closure.py
NUMERIC_TEST=tests/test_finite_aggregation.py
SQLITE_TEST=tests/test_sqlite_connection_hygiene.py
E=var/comprehensive-closure-v3
REPORT=/tmp/aspenops-comprehensive-v3-report.py
rm -rf "$E" dist /tmp/aspenops-comprehensive-v3-wheel
mkdir -p "$E"
cp "$PARTS/report.py.txt" "$REPORT"

cleanup_diagnostics() {
  rm -f \
    .github/sqlite-resource-audit.py.txt \
    .github/workflows/actions-status-diagnostic-once.yml \
    .github/workflows/sqlite-resource-audit-once.yml \
    .github/workflows/sqlite-resource-diagnostic-once.yml \
    .github/workflows/sqlite-static-inventory-once.yml \
    docs/ACTIONS_STATUS_DIAGNOSTIC.json \
    docs/SQLITE_RESOURCE_AUDIT.json \
    docs/SQLITE_RESOURCE_DIAGNOSTIC.json \
    docs/SQLITE_STATIC_INVENTORY.json \
    docs/COMPREHENSIVE_CODE_CLOSURE_BLOCKER.json
}

publish_commit() {
  if git push origin HEAD:main; then
    return 0
  fi
  git fetch origin main
  remote_delta="$(git diff --name-only "$BASE"..origin/main)"
  if [[ -n "$remote_delta" ]]; then
    printf 'Refusing to publish over non-equivalent remote tree changes:\n%s\n' "$remote_delta" >&2
    return 1
  fi
  git rebase origin/main
  git push origin HEAD:main
}

: > "$E/status.tsv"
failed=0
gate() {
  name="$1"; shift
  set +e
  "$@" >"$E/$name.log" 2>&1
  code=$?
  set -e
  printf '%s\t%s\n' "$name" "$code" >> "$E/status.tsv"
  [[ "$code" -eq 0 ]] || failed=1
}

gate apply-patch python "$PARTS/apply.py.txt"
gate copy-runtime-test cp "$PARTS/test_runtime_closure.py.txt" "$RUNTIME_TEST"
gate copy-numeric-test cp "$PARTS/test_finite_aggregation.py.txt" "$NUMERIC_TEST"
gate copy-sqlite-test cp "$PARTS/test_sqlite_connection_hygiene.py.txt" "$SQLITE_TEST"
gate copy-benchmark cp "$PARTS/benchmark.py.txt" "$E/benchmark.py"
gate copy-hygiene cp "$PARTS/hygiene.py.txt" "$E/hygiene.py"
gate copy-wheel-smoke cp "$PARTS/wheel_smoke.py.txt" "$E/wheel_smoke.py"
rm -rf "$PARTS"
rm -f "$SELF"
cleanup_diagnostics

CHANGED=(
  src/aspenops_nexus/cache.py
  src/aspenops_nexus/evaluation.py
  src/aspenops_nexus/optimization.py
  src/aspenops_nexus/pool.py
  src/aspenops_nexus/worker.py
  tests/test_cache.py
  tests/test_finite_aggregation.py
  tests/test_job_store.py
  tests/test_job_store_lease_recovery.py
  tests/test_job_store_lease_strictness.py
  tests/test_job_store_owner_fencing.py
  tests/test_runtime_closure.py
  tests/test_scheduler_edge_cases.py
  tests/test_scheduler_multiprocess_races.py
  tests/test_scheduler_restart_fencing.py
  tests/test_sqlite_connection_hygiene.py
)

gate sync-312 uv sync --python 3.12 --frozen --extra dev --extra agent --extra signing
gate ruff-fix uv run --python 3.12 ruff check --fix "${CHANGED[@]}"
gate format-fix uv run --python 3.12 ruff format "${CHANGED[@]}"
gate focused-tests uv run --python 3.12 pytest \
  -W error::ResourceWarning \
  -W error::pytest.PytestUnraisableExceptionWarning \
  "$RUNTIME_TEST" "$NUMERIC_TEST" "$SQLITE_TEST" \
  tests/test_pool_efficiency.py tests/test_singleflight.py \
  tests/test_cache.py tests/test_cache_write_efficiency.py \
  tests/test_result_serialization_efficiency.py tests/test_evaluation.py \
  tests/test_optimization.py tests/test_optimizer.py tests/test_job_store.py \
  tests/test_job_store_lease_recovery.py tests/test_job_store_lease_strictness.py \
  tests/test_job_store_owner_fencing.py tests/test_scheduler_edge_cases.py \
  tests/test_scheduler_multiprocess_races.py tests/test_scheduler_restart_fencing.py \
  --junitxml="$E/focused-junit.xml"
gate performance-benchmark uv run --python 3.12 python "$E/benchmark.py"
gate hygiene-audit uv run --python 3.12 python "$E/hygiene.py"
gate diff-check git diff --check
gate lock-check uv lock --check
gate dependency-audit bash -lc '
  set -euo pipefail
  export UV_PREVIEW_FEATURES=json-output
  bad=0
  for platform in linux windows; do
    for version in 3.11 3.12 3.13; do
      stem=var/comprehensive-closure-v3/audit-${platform}-${version}
      uv audit --frozen --python-platform "$platform" --python-version "$version" \
        --output-format json >"$stem.json" 2>"$stem.log" || bad=1
      python -m json.tool "$stem.json" >/dev/null || bad=1
    done
  done
  exit "$bad"
'
gate ruff uv run --python 3.12 ruff check .
gate format uv run --python 3.12 ruff format --check .
gate mypy uv run --python 3.12 mypy src
gate compileall uv run --python 3.12 python -m compileall -q src scripts
gate source-audit uv run --python 3.12 python scripts/audit_source_tree.py \
  --output "$E/source-tree-audit.json"
gate bandit bash -lc '
  set -euo pipefail
  status=0
  uv tool run --isolated --from bandit==1.9.4 bandit -r src scripts -lll -iii \
    -f json -o var/comprehensive-closure-v3/bandit.json \
    2>var/comprehensive-closure-v3/bandit.log || status=$?
  python -m json.tool var/comprehensive-closure-v3/bandit.json >/dev/null
  exit "$status"
'
gate diff-boundary bash -lc '
  set -euo pipefail
  bad="$(git diff --name-only "$BASE" | grep -Ev "^(src/aspenops_nexus/(cache|evaluation|optimization|pool|worker)\.py|tests/test_(cache|finite_aggregation|job_store|job_store_lease_recovery|job_store_lease_strictness|job_store_owner_fencing|runtime_closure|scheduler_edge_cases|scheduler_multiprocess_races|scheduler_restart_fencing|sqlite_connection_hygiene)\.py|\.github/comprehensive-closure-v3-parts/.*|\.github/workflows/comprehensive-code-closure-v3-once\.yml|\.github/sqlite-resource-audit\.py\.txt|\.github/workflows/actions-status-diagnostic-once\.yml|\.github/workflows/sqlite-resource-(audit|diagnostic)-once\.yml|\.github/workflows/sqlite-static-inventory-once\.yml|docs/(ACTIONS_STATUS_DIAGNOSTIC|SQLITE_RESOURCE_(AUDIT|DIAGNOSTIC)|SQLITE_STATIC_INVENTORY|COMPREHENSIVE_CODE_CLOSURE_(BLOCKER|RESULT))\.(json|md))$" || true)"
  if [[ -n "$bad" ]]; then
    printf "%s\n" "$bad"
    exit 1
  fi
'

gate sync-311 uv sync --python 3.11 --frozen --extra dev --extra agent --extra signing
gate full-3.11 uv run --python 3.11 pytest \
  -W error::ResourceWarning \
  -W error::pytest.PytestUnraisableExceptionWarning \
  --cov=aspenops_nexus --cov-branch --cov-fail-under=95.0 \
  --cov-report=json:"$E/coverage-3.11.json" --junitxml="$E/junit-3.11.xml"
gate sync-312-full uv sync --python 3.12 --frozen --extra dev --extra agent --extra signing
gate full-3.12 uv run --python 3.12 pytest \
  -W error::ResourceWarning \
  -W error::pytest.PytestUnraisableExceptionWarning \
  --cov=aspenops_nexus --cov-branch --cov-fail-under=95.0 \
  --cov-report=json:"$E/coverage-3.12.json" --junitxml="$E/junit-3.12.xml"
gate sync-313 uv sync --python 3.13 --frozen --extra dev --extra agent --extra signing
gate full-3.13 env PYTHONTRACEMALLOC=10 uv run --python 3.13 pytest \
  -W error::ResourceWarning \
  -W error::pytest.PytestUnraisableExceptionWarning \
  --cov=aspenops_nexus --cov-branch --cov-fail-under=95.0 \
  --cov-report=json:"$E/coverage-3.13.json" --junitxml="$E/junit-3.13.xml"
gate restore-312 uv sync --python 3.12 --frozen --extra dev --extra agent --extra signing
gate order-312 uv run --python 3.12 python scripts/run_test_order_gate.py \
  --output-dir "$E/order"
gate operation-counts uv run --python 3.12 python scripts/measure_operation_counts.py \
  --output "$E/operation-counts.json"
gate operation-counts-json python -m json.tool "$E/operation-counts.json"
gate process-ir uv run --python 3.12 python scripts/validate_process_ir.py \
  examples/process-intent.example.json \
  --canonical-output "$E/process-intent-canonical.json" \
  --report-output "$E/process-intent-report.json"
gate mcp uv run --python 3.12 python scripts/check_mcp.py
gate benchmark-smoke uv run --python 3.12 python scripts/run_benchmark_matrix.py \
  --repo-root . --output "$E/benchmark-smoke.json" --smoke
gate performance-policy uv run --python 3.12 python scripts/compare_benchmarks.py \
  --baseline var/benchmarks/baseline.json \
  --after var/benchmarks/after.json \
  --baseline-doc "$E/performance-baseline.md" \
  --after-doc "$E/performance-after.md" \
  --fail-on-stable-regression
gate build uv build
gate wheel-metadata uv run --python 3.12 python scripts/check_wheel_metadata.py \
  --dist-dir dist --output "$E/wheel-metadata.json"
gate wheel-smoke bash -lc '
  set -euo pipefail
  uv export --frozen --extra agent --no-default-groups --no-emit-project \
    --format requirements.txt --output-file var/comprehensive-closure-v3/runtime-requirements.txt
  uv venv --python 3.12 /tmp/aspenops-comprehensive-v3-wheel
  uv pip sync --python /tmp/aspenops-comprehensive-v3-wheel/bin/python --require-hashes \
    var/comprehensive-closure-v3/runtime-requirements.txt
  uv pip install --python /tmp/aspenops-comprehensive-v3-wheel/bin/python \
    --offline --no-deps dist/*.whl
  uv pip check --python /tmp/aspenops-comprehensive-v3-wheel/bin/python
  /tmp/aspenops-comprehensive-v3-wheel/bin/aspenops --version
  /tmp/aspenops-comprehensive-v3-wheel/bin/aspenops --help >/dev/null
  /tmp/aspenops-comprehensive-v3-wheel/bin/aspenops demo >/dev/null
  /tmp/aspenops-comprehensive-v3-wheel/bin/aspenops scheduler --help >/dev/null
  /tmp/aspenops-comprehensive-v3-wheel/bin/aspenops cancel --help >/dev/null
  /tmp/aspenops-comprehensive-v3-wheel/bin/aspenops optimize --help >/dev/null
  /tmp/aspenops-comprehensive-v3-wheel/bin/aspenops mcp --help >/dev/null
  /tmp/aspenops-comprehensive-v3-wheel/bin/python -W error::ResourceWarning \
    var/comprehensive-closure-v3/wheel_smoke.py
'

git config user.name github-actions[bot]
git config user.email 41898282+github-actions[bot]@users.noreply.github.com
if [[ "$failed" -ne 0 ]]; then
  git reset --hard "$BASE"
  rm -rf "$PARTS"
  rm -f "$SELF" "$RUNTIME_TEST" "$NUMERIC_TEST" "$SQLITE_TEST" \
    docs/COMPREHENSIVE_CODE_CLOSURE_RESULT.json \
    docs/COMPREHENSIVE_CODE_CLOSURE_RESULT.md \
    docs/COMPREHENSIVE_CODE_CLOSURE_BLOCKER.json
  cleanup_diagnostics
  python "$REPORT" --decision FAIL --evidence "$E"
  git add -A
  git commit -m 'test: record comprehensive code closure V3 blocker'
  publish_commit
  exit 1
fi

rm -f docs/COMPREHENSIVE_CODE_CLOSURE_BLOCKER.json
python "$REPORT" --decision PASS --evidence "$E"
git add -A
git commit -m 'fix: close all reproducible code issues'
publish_commit
